messages:
irene: Hit a TS inference weirdness on edge deploy: sdk.call with parse callback returns any in app. Works in Node.

jon: likely overload ordering + ESM types. bundle picks import entry d.ts.

sasha: can you share signatures?

irene: simplified: export function call(opts:{model:string}):Promise<string>; export function call<T>(opts:{model:string; parse:(s:string)=>T}):Promise<T>;

jon: replace with single generic default T=unknown or put generic overload first. Also add "types" to export import entry so ESM consumers see matching .d.ts.

irene: filing PR to collapse overloads, emit ESM .d.ts matching CJS, add CI tsc job with moduleResolution: bundler.

ci-bot: build sample/quickstart typecheck failed on branch fix/edge-typing (logs: https://ci.redwood/123).

sasha: add minimal repro and docs note about "type: module" and Vite defaults.

irene: will do, tracking here. thanks.
